example_note: WORKED EXAMPLE of the hash-pin + required-sections defense. Safe, reversible, NOT wired into any live gate or activation chain. Records real on-disk sha256 values for the two tools this package ships (so checkPinned() verifies against reality), but nothing consumes this manifest as an arming gate yet. A deployment with its own readiness verifier should build its own manifest of the same shape.

policy.hash_mismatch: REFUSED — a verifier whose on-disk sha256 != pinned sha256 is treated as drifted/tampered; its output MUST NOT be consumed by any gate.
policy.unknown_tool: REFUSED — a safety-critical tool not present in pinned_tools is not trusted (fail-closed, never trust-by-default).
policy.missing_section: FAIL — a required section absent from the verifier report is a silently-dropped safety check, NEVER 'not applicable'.
policy.short_section: FAIL — a required section present but with fewer than min_checks emitted is under-evaluated (partial data).

closure-hash.js.note: Computes the closure hash an approval binds to. On hash drift, treat any evidence produced with it as untrusted.

approval-sign.js.note: Signs and verifies operator approval records. Pinned so approval-minting/verification logic cannot drift without detection.

required_sections.report_shape: output.checks[] where each check.id is namespaced '<section>:<name>'; section = substring before the first ':'
required_sections.description: Worked example of the sections a readiness verifier for a world-spec pipeline MUST emit at least min_checks checks for. Adapt this list to your own verifier's addCheck() id namespaces. Absence of any of these in a produced report means the check family was dropped — treated as FAIL, never as not-applicable.

sections.rationale: Tool syntax/integrity checks — the verifier must confirm the gate tools parse.
Required-artifact existence checks — missing artifacts must surface, not be skipped.
Approval-fixture checks (approval-check + preflight) — the approval binding must be exercised.
Run-manifest integrity check — approved vs original manifest state.
